format: Privacy-filtered derived evidence; not raw execution logs.

result.input: deterministic complete byte patterns; exceptional scales included
deterministic complete byte patterns; exceptional scales included

differential.scope: Actual import.cpp convert_rows; q4_0/q4_1/q4_k, zero/partial ranges and nonzero source offsets, permuted and unpermuted. Differential baseline plus canaries; real-row independent oracle separate.

sanitizer_and_mutant.mutant_definition: Identity head index instead of required grouped-to-tiled permutation; real-row independent oracle rejects before timing.

source_contract: Import metadata validation requires DeltaNet value-head width128 and divisible key/value head counts. Internal output code/scale/bias buffers are separate.
limitations: Q4_1/Q4_K checks compare complete baseline/candidate output bytes with canaries. The independent nibble/half/BF16 oracle is on actual Q4_0 rows.
